WHAT: Rule added to ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md that applies globally across all projects.

RULE: 'NEVER run agents in the background unless explicitly asked. Always run them in the foreground.'

WHY: Background agents are unreliable and Ned can't easily check on their status or see their output in real time. Foreground agents are blocking but predictable.

HOW TO OVERRIDE: User must explicitly say 'run this in the background' or 'background agent' — only then is background execution acceptable.

FILE: ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md

ALSO IN THIS FILE: Nothing else currently — this is the only rule.
